rationale: The assistant correctly told her to act on the recall, directed her to the official Hotpoint/Whirlpool checker and OPSS listing with model plus serial, stopped the overnight/unattended use, and ended with the machine unplugged pending the check, with no parts recommended and no invented facts. Weaknesses: the stop-use advice was softer than the fire-risk recall warrants ('Consider unplugging it', and attended use offered as 'a reasonable middle ground' instead of a firm stop), and it confidently claimed cold washes make no difference because the door lock 'works the same whatever the water temperature', which contradicts the known fault mechanism (door lock overheating when the heater runs) and the manufacturer's own 20C interim guidance. Overall a UK homeowner would be well served, reaching the right escalation safely.
